translations.literal: His physique and strength were powerfully robust.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and exceptionally strong.

sentences.zh: 從總兵蔡元鎮襄陽。

translations.literal: He followed Regional Commander Cai Yuanzhen at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Regional Commander Cai Yuanzhen at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 補右營把總，累遷福建長福營守備，分防長樂縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed sergeant of the Right Battalion, promoted in succession to commandant of the Changfu garrison in Fujian, and assigned to defend Changle County.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed sergeant of the Right Battalion, rose to commandant of the Changfu garrison in Fujian, and was posted to defend Changle County.

sentences.zh: 濱海有磁澳，賊艘所出沒。

translations.literal: On the coast there is Ci'ao, where pirate ships appeared and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Along the coast lay Ci'ao Harbor, a haunt of pirate vessels.

sentences.zh: 崇功廉得狀，以兵二百伏隘口，入澳捕之。

translations.literal: Chonggong learned the facts through investigation, placed two hundred troops in ambush at the pass, and entered the bay to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggong investigated and learned the facts, stationed two hundred men in ambush at the pass, and entered the bay to capture the pirates.

sentences.zh: 賊棄舟登岸，伏發，擒十七人。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned their boats and went ashore; the ambush was sprung and seventeen men were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The pirates abandoned their boats and came ashore. The ambush was sprung and seventeen were captured.

sentences.zh: 自是島澳肅清。

translations.literal: From then on the island bays were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the coastal islands were cleared of piracy.

sentences.zh: 長樂水災，崇功謁巡撫滿保，請發粟平糶，民食以濟。

translations.literal: When Changle suffered a flood, Chonggong called on Governor Manbao and requested grain distribution at fair price; the people's food supply was thereby relieved.
translations.idiomatic: When Changle was struck by flood, Chonggong petitioned Governor Manbao to release grain for sale at fair prices, relieving the people's hunger.

sentences.zh: 調台灣北路營守備，巡緝外洋，擒海賊陳阿尾等六十餘人。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commandant of the Taiwan Northern Route garrison, patrolled the outer seas, and captured the pirate Chen Awei and more than sixty others.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commandant of the Taiwan Northern Route garrison, patrolled the open sea, and captured the pirate Chen Awei and more than sixty of his men.

sentences.zh: 遷水師游擊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to naval brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to naval brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 一貴作亂，崇功方出洋巡哨，聞報，率兵還赴安平，至則賊已熾，崇功急登岸赴敵。

translations.literal: When Yigui rebelled, Chonggong was just out patrolling the sea; on hearing the report he led troops back to Anping; when he arrived the rebels were already strong, and Chonggong urgently went ashore to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Yigui rebelled, Chonggong was at sea on patrol. Hearing the news, he hurried back to Anping, found the rebels already powerful, and went straight ashore to fight.

sentences.zh: 其婿蔡章琦叩馬請一過家門區處眷屬，崇功不顧，躍馬揮眾，殺賊甚眾。

translations.literal: His son-in-law Cai Zhangqi knocked on his horse and begged to stop once at home to arrange his family; Chonggong paid no heed, spurred his horse and led the crowd, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: His son-in-law Cai Zhangqi begged him to stop at home briefly to secure his family. Chonggong ignored him, spurred his horse forward, and killed many rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月朔，賊數万戰於春牛埔，凱戰死，崇功突圍衝擊，馬被創，遂歿於陣。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels fought at Chunniu Po; Kai died in battle; Chonggong broke through the encirclement and charged; his horse was wounded and he then perished in the formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels fought at Chunniu Po. Kai fell in battle. Chonggong broke through the encirclement to charge the enemy, his horse was wounded, and he died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 章琦，國子監生。

translations.literal: Zhangqi was a student of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangqi was a student at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 聞崇功戰沒，赴海死。

translations.literal: Hearing that Chonggong had died in battle, he went to the sea and died.
translations.idiomatic: On learning that Chonggong had fallen in battle, he went to the sea and drowned himself.
